title: Polynomial runtime envelope
statement: For natural numbers $n$ and $k$, and a rational failure parameter $\delta$ with $0<\delta\leq 1/2$, let $d$ be the low-degree junta polynomial degree at $k$, and let $b$ be the failure-bit count at the quarter-failure parameter associated to $\delta$. The polynomial runtime envelope is $3\bigl(2^d(d+b+3)\bigr)^3(n+1)^{3d}$.
caveat: The supplied definitions do not specify the low-degree, quarter-failure, or failure-bit functions beyond their names; the formula records their exact placement.
